title: ProducerChange Schema
description: Schema for producer changes in Producerflow

producer_id.description: Always present. Unique identifier for the producer

external_id.description: Only present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the producer

agency_id.description: Always present. ID of the agency that the producer belongs to

external_agency_id.description: Only present if filled in by tenant. External ID of the agency that the producer belongs to

accurate_background_check.description: Present when producer background check is added or updated. Contains background check information

producer_data.description: Present when producer is created or when any producer data field (city, email, first_name, last_name, middle_name, phone, state, street, address_line_2, zip, is_sole_proprietor) is updated. Contains the producer's personal and contact information

is_sole_proprietor.description: Whether the producer is a sole proprietor

is_principal.description: Whether the producer is the principal/lead agent of the agency

producer_nipr_data.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the producer. Contains producer information from NIPR

producer_nipr_appointments.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the producer. Contains all current carrier appointments from NIPR

producer_nipr_licenses.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the producer. Contains all current licenses with their LOAs from NIPR

producer_nipr_addresses.description: Present when NIPR data is synced for the producer. Contains all addresses from NIPR

requested_appointment_states.description: Present when producer is created or when the requested appointment states are updated. Contains the list of US state codes where appointments are requested. When present, this field is always an array (never null); an empty array indicates all requested states have been cleared

nipr_sync_status.description: Always present. NIPR synchronization status of the producer (disabled, pending, failing, active)

nipr_sync_status_updated_at.description: Always present. ISO 8601 timestamp when the NIPR synchronization status was last updated

organization.description: Present when the producer's agency organization assignment changes. Contains organization details

organization_id.description: Unique internal identifier for the organization

external_id.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the organization from an external system

email.description: Contact email address for the organization

metadata_questions.description: Deprecated: Use tenant_additional_questions instead. Custom metadata questions and answers in JSON string format. This field will be removed in a future release.

tenant_additional_questions.description: Present when the tenant_additional_questions field changes. An empty object ({}) means the field was cleared; absent means the field was not changed in this event. Contains custom additional questions and answers as key-value pairs collected during producer onboarding

external_metadata.description: Present when the external_metadata field changes. An empty object ({}) means the field was cleared; absent means the field was not changed in this event. Contains tenant-specific metadata as key-value pairs allowing tenants to attach their own business attributes, computed values, or derived data to producers

assigned_locations.description: Present when producer location assignments change. Contains locations assigned to the producer. When a location is unassigned, it will be included in the array with unassigned=true along with all remaining assigned locations.

address_line_2.description: Second line of the street address (e.g., apartment, suite, unit number)

phone.description: Contact phone number for this location

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary location for the producer

unassigned.description: When true, indicates this location has been unassigned from the producer. This follows the same pattern as organization unassignment.

contract_status.description: Present when producer contract status changes. Current status of the producer's contract

onboarding_status.description: Present when producer onboarding status changes. Tracks the producer's progress through the onboarding workflow

onboarding_status_updated_at.description: Present when producer onboarding status changes. ISO 8601 timestamp when the onboarding status was last updated
